invariants.contract: Future target tick, delta_true, y_true and recursive future observed context are label/evaluation data only; never inference inputs.
Gate STATIC holds the supplied current integer tick on the successful frozen path; this need not equal observed truth after recursive drift.
Gate MOVE does not require nonzero projected movement. MOVE to HOLD remains permitted.
Frozen np.rint ties-to-even and after-rounding signed16 range rejection remain unchanged; no clipping, new deadband or forced movement.
Observed truth context and actual observed/projected routing context remain separately named; binary equality does not imply numeric-history equality.
Source-grid delta sign/presence is not physical EPS movement, torque or proven signed rate.
Existing Stage2 model, both normalizers, shared raw-feature dimension, fit policy and selector remain byte-identical.
No HOLDOUT admission, pooled refit, composition, vehicle authority or future execution arises from this contract review.
Full eligible history and continuous within-segment anchors are required; no padding, default context or cross-segment bridge.

One frozen TRAIN decision belongs to each candidate/fold job and is shared across its two heads; each fold retains its own frozen labels/anchor identities while their definitions and anchor semantics remain common.
No new onset/termination acceptance cutoff is derived from retrospective results; frozen32 clauses and both-fold requirement remain unchanged.
Recursive state belongs to each local path/horizon; future logged command/speed is supplied retrospective input, not proven initial-anchor forecast information.
